title: The LLENS Platform for On-Premises Large Language Model Agents in a Japanese University Hospital: Development and Evaluation Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.32151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents that use tools could take on part of the electronic health record and desk work that occupies physicians' time, but in many hospitals the medical information systems run inside closed networks, so the model and the agent harness must also sit inside. We designed, implemented, and deployed LLENS, a clinical support AI agent platform that runs inside the closed network of Hokkaido University Hospital on one host with 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, the open-weight model Kimi K2.6 (~1 trillion parameters), and a web application rebuilt from Open WebUI. The harness has 10 components, including page image reading, full-text attachment input, a path-addressed document tree without a vector index, a network-isolated sandbox, artifact return, self-checking of generated output, subagents, and saved procedures. Kimi K2.6 was chosen from 3 open-weight candidates and scored 480/500 on the 2026 Japanese Medical Licensing Examination

translated_title: 日本某大学医院本地部署大语言模型智能体的LLENS平台：开发与评估研究
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.32151v1，公告类型：交叉）：使用工具的大语言模型智能体可以分担占用医生时间的部分电子病历和案头文书工作，但在许多医院中，医疗信息系统运行在封闭网络内，因此模型和智能体框架也必须部署在其中。我们设计、实现并部署了LLENS——一个在北海道大学医院封闭网络内运行的临床支持AI智能体平台，部署于配备8块NVIDIA H200 GPU的单台主机上，采用开放权重模型Kimi K2.6（约1万亿参数），并使用基于Open WebUI重构的Web应用。该智能体框架包含10个组件，包括页面图像读取、全文附件输入、无需向量索引的路径寻址文档树、网络隔离沙箱、工件返回、生成输出的自检、子智能体以及已保存的操作流程。Kimi K2.6是从3个开放权重候选模型中选出的，并在2026年日本医师执业资格考试中获得了480/500的成绩。
tldr: 研究团队在北海道大学医院的封闭网络内开发并部署了基于万亿参数开放权重模型Kimi K2.6的临床支持AI智能体平台LLENS，该模型在日本医师执业资格考试中取得480/500的高分，验证了本地化部署医疗AI智能体的可行性。
en_tdlr: Researchers developed and deployed LLENS, a clinical support AI agent platform running entirely within the closed network of Hokkaido University Hospital using the ~1 trillion-parameter open-weight model Kimi K2.6, which scored 480/500 on the 2026 Japanese Medical Licensing Examination, demonstrating the feasibility of on-premises medical AI agents.
